summary: Added Graph.cbd(resource) to rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) implementing the W3C CBD rules 1–3 with a nested add_to_cbd helper, exact BNode type check, and the spec's cycle guard. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering direct counts, empty result, blank nodes, typed/untyped reifiers (8 and 13 triples), incoming reification, blank-node non-expansion under reifiers, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Nothing was run: the tests and expected counts were verified by hand only. No commits were made.
